snippet.title: Tiny Eden - Demo Trailer
snippet.description:
Play demo on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3375110/Tiny_Eden

A peaceful first-person farming sim in the heart of a futuristic city. Turn your small apartment into a thriving smart garden. Grow plants, cook meals, sell your harvest, and expand your urban farm - from a single windowsill all the way to a rooftop paradise.

Join us on Discord → https://discord.gg/tinyedengame
Follow us on X → https://twitter.com/TinyEdenGame
Watch us on TikTok → https://www.tiktok.com/@tinyedengame
Explore on Instagram → https://www.instagram.com/tinyedengame
